name: kompkit
description: A lightweight cross-platform utility kit for Web (TypeScript), Android (Kotlin), and Flutter (Dart): debounce, isEmail, formatCurrency

scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:android && npm run test:flutter
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:android && npm run lint:flutter
scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:android && npm run format:flutter
scripts.clean: npm run clean:web && npm run clean:android && npm run clean:flutter
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:docs
scripts.docs:all: npm run docs:web && npm run docs:android && npm run docs:flutter
scripts.docs:clean: npm run clean:docs && npm run docs:all
scripts.serve:all: concurrently "npm run serve:web" "npm run serve:android" "npm run serve:flutter"
scripts.dev:docs: npm run docs:all && npm run serve:all
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.check:web: npm run lint:web && npm run test:web
scripts.check:android: npm run lint:android && npm run test:android
scripts.check:flutter: npm run lint:flutter && npm run test:flutter
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/core/flutter && flutter packages get
scripts.deps:update: npm update && cd packages/core/flutter && flutter packages upgrade
scripts.release:prepare: npm run clean:all && npm run install:all && npm run check && npm run build && npm run docs:all
scripts.ci: npm run install:all && npm run check && npm run build
